summary: zSpace, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a debt restructuring agreement (May 28, 2026) converting ~$12M in outstanding convertible notes owed to holders 3i, LP and Fiza Investments into common and newly created Series P-2 convertible preferred stock. Specifically, $2M of 3i's principal and interest are converted at $0.2385 per share (150% of prior closing price), fully satisfying one note. The remaining 3i note is amended, and Fiza's entire balance converts. The board likely recommended this to reduce leverage. No advisor named. The restructuring eliminates near-term cash interest and reduces debt overhang. Watch for shareholder dilution and conversion mechanics of the new preferred series.
